name: print-social-ad-phone-neon-geometric-purple
title: Purple digital-technology ad with neon geometric planes
whatItIs: A square digital-technology ad on a deep purple background, with a tilted phone floating amid overlapping neon-outlined geometric planes and pink/blue glow accents.
whatItMeans: Overlapping semi-transparent neon planes behind the product suggest depth and digital energy without needing a busy background photo.
techniques: layer several overlapping semi-transparent geometric planes at different angles for depth
edge geometric shapes with thin neon outline strokes rather than solid fills
tilt the hero product diagonally to break the grid formed by the background planes

vocabulary.definition: a flat 2D shape used in layered compositions to imply depth or structure without full 3D rendering
